email.name: Elena Marsh
email.subject: Arriving Friday - a few questions
email.body:
Hi there,

We're checking in this Friday (booking BR-1042) and I have a few questions:

1. We'd love to bring our dog Biscuit. She's about 30 lbs. Is that OK and what's the fee?
2. Could we check out late on Monday? I'm a Gold member.
3. Can you arrange a pickup from MIA for the two of us on Friday afternoon? Our flight lands at 2:15 PM.

Thanks so much!
Elena

record.draft:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and Biscuit on Friday.

1. Pets: Dogs up to 40 lbs are welcome, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, so Biscuit is well within our limit. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant.

2. Late check-out: Late check-out on weekends is capped at 12:00 PM for all guests, including Gold members [P7]. Monday is not a weekend, so your Gold benefit may apply, which is check-out at 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P8][P6]. I've passed your request to our front desk, and they will confirm.

3. MIA pickup: We can arrange this. A sedan is $65 one way for up to 3 guests, and transfers must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P9]. I've sent the request to our reservations team to confirm the booking for your 2:15 PM arrival. The team will confirm the final details and total.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and cannot be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We have passed your request to our front desk, who will check your cabin's readiness and confirm with you. Any early check-in fee will be confirmed by the team.

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way, runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We have requested a shuttle for your party of three arriving at 11:00 AM on Friday. Please reply with your flight number so we can confirm the booking.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

requests.summary: Is a 60 lb Labrador allowed in December?
How much is parking?
Is there a resort fee?

record.draft:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Unfortunately, dogs are only welcome up to 40 lbs, so a 60 lb Labrador would not be accommodated at Beach Resort. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant. Service animals are always welcome with no fee. [P1]

Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served. [P6]

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day. [P3]

If you have any other questions, just let us know.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Thanks so much!
Elena

record.draft:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and Biscuit on Friday!

1. Dogs: Dogs up to 40 lbs are welcome, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, so Biscuit is fine. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1].

2. Late check-out: Our weekend late check-out cap applies to Saturday and Sunday check-outs only [P6]. Since your departure is Monday 9 Nov, Gold members can check out until 2:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [P7][P8].

3. Airport pickup: We offer MIA pickups. A sedan (up to 3 guests) is $65 one way, booked at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. We have passed your Friday 2:15 PM arrival to our concierge team, who will confirm the booking with you.

A manager is not needed for these requests. Please let us know if you have any other questions.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

record.draft:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Unfortunately, our pet policy does not accommodate a 60 lb Labrador. Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, and the pet fee is $75 per stay (non-refundable). Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee.

Parking is valet only at $45 per night with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served [P6].

There is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax, which includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P4].

If you'd like to check dates for a stay, please send your preferred check-in and check-out dates and we will be glad to look at availability.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort
